scientific_question: Is the rapidly rotating V/O quotient tangent bundle causally trackable from a compact window of strictly past chords and optimizer directions?

teacher_upper_bound.purpose: Necessary-condition test before designing a structured moving chart; a pass does not authorize training.

selection_and_test.window_selection_phase: chords from 1200 through 1740 and Muon tangent 1782
selection_and_test.frozen_test_phase: chords beginning at 1800 and Muon tangent 2372
selection_and_test.selection_score: minimum of aggregate, every-layer, and late-layer recovery across selection chords and Muon tangents
selection_and_test.causality: Each target atlas contains only chords ending no later than target start and probes strictly earlier than target time.
selection_and_test.coordinate_budget: one percent of paired V/O parameters; actual atoms are at most window plus four past probes

decision_rule.pass: Authorize only a compact structured causal moving-atlas design and offline approximation gate.
decision_rule.fail: Past tangent memory is insufficient; require a nonlinear state-conditioned or token-conditional V/O chart rather than a moving affine basis.
